text:
jordan: Quick weekly capacity check — attaching the forecast we ran this morning. TL;DR: projected GPU-hours for Jul 10–16 up 34% vs last week due to marketing demo + a new internal eval. Need region-level readiness and any cluster-level constraints.

leah: saw the forecast — big chunk in eu-west. Are we hitting the 3 TB/day egress cap?

mike: eu-west egress is currently at 78% of cap during business hours. If demos go live we'll hit cap on Tue afternoon. Suggest shifting noncritical batch to eu-north.

sam: apac spot inventory is noisy. Preemptible rate jumped to ~22% this morning for h100 pool, causing retries in the inference pipeline. We're throttling microbatching to reduce retry blast.

jordan: noted. Can we get a quick cluster-by-cluster snapshot? I care about: free GPU hours, preemptible fraction, network headroom, and local KV cache hit%.

leah: eu-west-a: free 380h (A100), preemptible 8%, net headroom 22% (egress), kv cache hit 54%
leah: eu-west-b: free 120h (A100+H100 mix), preemptible 28% (higher), net headroom 9% (we're close)

mike: us-west-2: free 510h (H100), preemptible 3%, net headroom 45%, kv hit 67%

sam: apac-southeast: free 90h (H100 preemptible-heavy), preemptible 36%, net headroom 12%

ops-bot: [autoscaler] Scale-up event executed in us-west-2 - added 4 nodes at 11:02 UTC

sre-bot: [billing-alert] Estimated incremental spend for next week: ~$48k if forecast holds

jordan: thanks. Actionable proposals: 1) Move 20% of eu-west demo traffic to us-west-2 during peak hours via smart-routing policy. 2) Increase reserved H100 burst in apac by +2 nodes for Jul 11–14. 3) Temp lower queue depth for low-priority batches to preserve headroom. Thoughts?

leah: +1 to moving demo traffic, but we need to avoid cross-region latency hitting SLAs for EU customers. Suggest using a canary: route 10% first, monitor P95 latency.

mike: agree. Also suggest enabling KV prefetch for demo prompts — should improve kv hit by ~8–12% and cut intra-model tokens, reducing load. I can flip the flag tonight.

sam: for apac burst, FYI procurement says spot pools are volatile; recommend reserved rolling + ephemeral fallback to A100 if H100 preemptible drops >30%.

jordan: noted. I'll open the rollout:
```
/routing update --name demo-global --policy smart-route --primary eu-west --fallback us-west-2 --percent 10 --monitor 15m
/infra change --region apac-southeast --add-reserved h100 2 --duration 2026-07-11:00:00_2026-07-14:23:59
```

leah: small ask — can we also bump per-route token cap for demo to 4096? current default 2048 causes trimming and extra calls.

jordan: will include. But note cost impact — hitting 4k doubles token bill on that route. sre-bot, what's the estimated incremental cost if we increase to 4k for demo route at projected demo volume?

sre-bot: [calc] Demo route incremental token cost (est): +$6.4k/week if 10% of traffic routed to us-west and avg output 3.2k tokens/req

mike: still within the ~$48k extra we saw, but we should offset with cache tuning and reduced microbatch size for background jobs.

sam: ops alert — we'll schedule a maintenance window Tue 02:00–03:00 UTC for apac reserved node prep. Minimal impact expected, will drain gracefully.

jordan: good. Can owners ack on the rollout plan by EOD so I can trigger changes overnight? Owners: @leah (eu-west), @mike (us-west-2), @sam (apac).

leah: ack — will watch canary and escalate if p95 > 220ms

mike: ack — flipping KV prefetch tonight and monitoring token/throughput ratio

sam: ack — will orchestrate reserved node add and fallback policy, will post runbook in #eng-infra if anything odd

jordan: final notes for the weekly email: forecasted peak GPU-hours 14.2k (week), risk: eu-west egress cap, apac spot volatility; mitigations: routing canary, +2 reserved H100 in apac, KV prefetch. I'll draft the note and ping product for demo timing.

leah: tiny ask — can we capture expected impact on unit latency and cost per 1k requests in the email? product will want that.

jordan: yes. I'll add an appendix with expected P95 delta and $/1k req approx.

mike: +:thumbsup:

sre-bot: [note] Thread summary saved to /reports/weekly/2790012345-summary.txt

jordan: thanks team — catching up tomorrow at 10:30 for a quick post-rollout readout. :white_check_mark:
